bugLogs.title: Insufficient Color Contrast
affected_users: older users with declining contrast sensitivity
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The visual presentation of text and images of text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1
bugLogs.actual_behavior: Elements have insufficient color contrast (1.6 and 2.93) against their backgrounds
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Increase text darkness or lighten background to achieve 4.5:1 ratio

bugLogs.title: Missing Image Alt Text
affected_users: blind users who use screen readers
users with low vision who use text enlargement
users with cognitive disabilities who benefit from text descriptions
users on slow connections who disable images
steps_to_reproduce: Verify the absence of an alt attribute or alternative text
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The image should have alternative text that serves the equivalent purpose, such as a descriptive alt attribute.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The image is missing an alt attribute, aria-label, and aria-labelledby, and does not have a title attribute or role="none" or role="presentation" to indicate it is decorative.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a descriptive alt attribute to the img element, such as alt="Red shoe detail". Alternatively, use aria-label or aria-labelledby to provide a text alternative.

bugLogs.title: Missing Label on Form Input
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to the form input element
Verify that the input element does not have a visible label
Verify that the input element does not have an explicit or implicit label
Verify that the input element does not have an aria-label or aria-labelledby attribute
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The form input element should have a visible, persistent label or an explicit/implicit label associated with it
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The form input element does not have a visible, persistent label or an explicit/implicit label associated with it
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a visible, persistent label above or beside the form input element, or use the 'for' attribute to associate a label with the input element
